as_of: 2026-09-20, of3t-orchestrator pass 198. CPU only. An ARBITRATION of of3t-nanfloor's device results; no measurement here is mine.
headline: The repair I landed blind works and is 17.8x better than the form that was measured, but the DEFECT I filed alongside it explains nothing: the softmax_accurate arm never went through the code path whose dropped config I blamed, and with the config installed and absent it reads 1.076374e-01 both ways with 547 tensors bit-identical. The four-arm argument stands and the 51.1358 % scope is settled.

my_inference_that_was_refuted.what_I_claimed: D113 -- both `_fp32_softmax_tail` call sites drop the compute kernel config, so the chain's fp32 reduction ran at the op default, and `softmax_accurate`'s published 1.323x was measured that way
my_inference_that_was_refuted.what_is_true: the dropped config is real and is fixed. The ARM does not go through those call sites -- it installs its own rule on the tape verb and has passed `_SOFTMAX_PRECISE_CKC` since it was written (8f413dae4 through _accurate_softmax, 8b6963af8 inlined).
my_inference_that_was_refuted.the_error_named: I read the shipped path's source and asserted it was the path the measurement took. `the source says it is passed` and `it reached the op` are different claims and I checked only the first.

measured_refutation.census_proving_the_arms_differed: fwd_precise 1440 / fwd_none 0 against fwd_precise 0 / fwd_none 1440, over 1,440 intercepted softmax calls each
measured_refutation.shipped_control: 7.426217e+00, and its 547 tensors bit-identical to of3t-softgrad's shipped dump -- a stronger control than the headline agreeing
measured_refutation.clocks: shipped 63 s at mean 1316 MHz, both accurate arms 104 s at 1329 MHz, AICLK sampled DURING, host_quiet green at loadavg 0.27 against a 2.00 ceiling

my_inference_that_was_refuted.consequence: the pre-registered third band fires. No on-device configuration reaches the bar; the 51.1358 % scope is settled as the pass-193 NO-GO had it, and PARTIAL now rests on the trunk gradient alone.

the_repair_itself_came_out_better_than_r.pre_registered: 0 non-finite and rel_l2 within 1 % of of3t-softgrad's 0.011574924
the_repair_itself_came_out_better_than_r.why: of3t-softgrad's accurate_clamp60 arm also clamps the TOP at 0 (ttnn.minimum(d, 0.0)), which pulls the largest exponent from exp(+0.0625) to exp(0) on every row where ttnn.max reads short. The row reproduced that both-sided form and it reads 0.01157492424155284, the published digits exactly.
the_repair_itself_came_out_better_than_r.why_that_is_not_luck: the commit that landed the one-sided clamp rejected the top clamp explicitly, on the argument that clamping d at 0 flattens every entry above the truncated maximum and destroys their ordering. The measurement is 17.8x in favour of the argued choice.
the_repair_itself_came_out_better_than_r.also: the shipped one-sided floor is 2.15x better than the FUSED kernel (1.3958e-03) on the same input
the_repair_itself_came_out_better_than_r.blast_radius_at_op_level: every row with a live maximum is bit-identical to the unfloored chain; the 114,688 non-finite entries on the masked rows go to 0
the_repair_itself_came_out_better_than_r.immunity_invariant_confirmed_on_hardware: on an input exactly on the bf16 grid, ttnn.max overshoots by exactly 0.0 and falls short by exactly 0.0 -- the pass-194 argument, measured

the_backward_hazard_was_real_and_order_d.flagged_in_the_brief: 1/s**2 on a ~1.1e-24 sum is past fp32's 3.4e38
the_backward_hazard_was_real_and_order_d.measured: 1/s = 8.925e+23 squares to 7.96e+47 and overflows, 114,688 non-finite; dividing by s TWICE is finite
the_backward_hazard_was_real_and_order_d.what_the_arm_actually_uses: an analytic rule, y*(g - sum(g*y)), which never divides by the row sum: finite, rel_l2 7.352071e-04 against the float64 analytic backward

and_my_proposed_alternative_is_measured_.what_I_suggested: floor the SUM instead -- bit-identical on any row with a live maximum, and a [.., 1] op rather than a full-size one
and_my_proposed_alternative_is_measured_.measured: finite, bit-identical on live rows, needs its floor at 1e-18 or above to keep 1/s**2 in range -- but masked rows come back as ZEROS rather than the uniform distribution the softmax of a constant row actually is. rel_l2 0.167 overall against 6.494e-04 for the exponent floor.
and_my_proposed_alternative_is_measured_.verdict: 257x worse. Keep the exponent floor. The suggestion was mine and offering it as the cheaper option was right to do and wrong on the numbers.

what_is_still_owed_on_this_row: Deliverable 3 -- one OpenDDE fold at a non-bucket-aligned token count, finite and bit-identical to the unfloored tree BY DIGEST. The blast radius above is measured at the op. Generalising it to a shipped model without the fold is the step D63 exists to stop.
provenance: of3t-orchestrator pass 198 on pc, CPU only, no device opened. Every measurement is of3t-nanfloor's, read from origin/wk/of3t-nanfloor at 28854d22b. The arbitration and the retraction are this pass's.
